form_evidence.rationale: Randomized three-period crossover in 21 healthy adults aged 65-74 comparing ubiquinol capsules against ubiquinone capsules head to head. Ubiquinol was NOT significantly more bioavailable than ubiquinone (1.7-fold, 95% CI 0.9-3.1, p = 0.129), and plasma CoQ10 appeared mostly as ubiquinol even when consumed as ubiquinone. This supports the parity encoded here: ubiquinol and ubiquinone crystal-dispersed both sit at 13. The study's one significant result was for a water-soluble syrup formulation (2.4-fold), i.e. a solubilization effect rather than a redox-form premium.
